English: Uncle Olson is out... Where did he go?

Perhaps he's taken a long trip
without leaving a house-sitter behind?

Or maybe those guys went
back and suddenly offed him...
I think you're reaching a little too far.

I believe my uncle's been
dealing with his own hardships.
You know, you're being too damn soft on him.

I made it out alive. That's
all that matters right now.
